temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose notices Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual at work. When he asks if she is okay, she says it is personal stuff and thanks him for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is normally vibrant and has not previously had a confirmed reason to worry about her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jose now believes something personal is troubling Patricia, though she is not ready to share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is likely dealing with personal issues and may need space, but she seems to appreciate his concern.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer non-pressuring support and let Patricia know he is available to listen if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. In conversation, Patricia admits she has been overwhelmed with bills and says discussing budgeting could be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia has personal issues but does not know their nature; he wants to help without prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jose learns that Patricia's personal stress includes financial concerns, and she seems open to discussing budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially stressed and may be receptive to practical help with budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to discuss budgeting and financial planning with Patricia when she feels ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks with Patricia about whether he overstepped by bringing up financial planning. Patricia says she did not think he was prying and that she is grateful for his offer to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worries that Patricia might think he crossed a boundary by discussing her finances, even though he meant to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Patricia's reassurance reduces Jose's worry and confirms that his support was welcomed rather than intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his help and does not view him as overstepping; Jose can support her as a friend while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue respecting Patricia's privacy while remaining available as a supportive friend.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in casually. Patricia says everything is good and she is planning a quiet weekend. She is polite but does not share details. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support and may still be open to help, but he remains mindful of boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jose now more clearly believes Patricia appreciates concern but wants to keep her personal matters private.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his supportive presence, but she likely prefers handling her issues privately and without pressure.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain friendly, low-pressure check-ins and offer availability without prying into her private matters.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues checking in with Patricia at work and offers help, even if just grabbing a coffee. Patricia says she is busy but handling it, thanks him for checking in, and says his support is really great.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates low-pressure support but prefers to handle her personal issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes/confirms: Patricia seems to be managing her situation and explicitly values Jose's supportive presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling things and welcomes Jose's continued supportive check-ins as a coworker and friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular low-pressure check-ins and offer practical or friendly help when appropriate.
